title: Caring for and reusing materials
misconception: 1E-M2: thinks reusing means sending to a factory (confuses reuse and recycle)
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: To reuse is to use a thing again, as it is, or for a new job.
An empty tin can become a pencil holder.
A strong sack from the market can carry goods again and again.
To recycle is different. The material is broken down and made into something new.
Old plastic bottles can be recycled into new plastic things.
You can reuse at home. You do not need a factory.
Reusing and recycling mean less waste on our streets and in our drains.
Now it is your turn. Say how you would reuse a material.
